key_provenance: Public RSA-4096 test key committed in fixtures/data; not a linkedin key. Anyone can sign with it.
notes: The provider's ID tokens carry no nonce, so the fixture binds no challenge (bearer).
iat is 60 s before --now; the adapter reads the signed iat, and exp - iat is 86400 s.

later_payload() is the same claims with iat one second later and the same exp, signed by the fixture key; other_key_signature() signs the fixture token under the key from the seed label 'uc login-link other rs256-4096 key v1' (x509.py seeded_key), whose modulus exceeds the fixture key's. The importer checks both tokens.
Negative cases mutate this fixture in src/test.nr.
